blocks.alt: How ChatGPT Targets Ads To You Based On Your Prompts, Phone Number, and Email

blocks.text: 据 404 Media 对 ChatGPT 广告生态系统进行的测试，OpenAI 允许任何人向 ChatGPT 用户的会话中注入广告，并根据用户的电子邮件地址、电话号码或手机上的唯一标识符来定位特定人群。

inlines.text: 据 404 Media 对 ChatGPT 广告生态系统进行的测试，OpenAI 允许任何人向 ChatGPT 用户的会话中注入广告，并根据用户的电子邮件地址、电话号码或手机上的唯一标识符来定位特定人群。

blocks.text: 虽然 ChatGPT 中提供的广告定向在广告行业中算是相当常规的做法，但这款聊天机器人的 十亿月活跃用户 可能并不明白，在某些情况下，他们之所以被专门针对，是因为广告主上传到 OpenAI 的个人数据。ChatGPT 的广告定向还有一个新颖之处：它还会基于用户输入聊天机器人的提示词，用户可能以为这些提示词是私密的，但正如 404 Media 此前所展示的，它们可能会被人工审查。或者在这种情况下，被用于广告定向目的。

blocks.alt: How ChatGPT Targets Ads To You Based On Your Prompts, Phone Number, and Email

blocks.text: OpenAI lets anyone inject ads into ChatGPT users’ sessions, targeting specific groups of people based on their email address, phone number, or a unique identifier on their phone, according to 404 Media’s own tests of ChatGPT’s advertising ecosystem.

inlines.text: OpenAI lets anyone inject ads into ChatGPT users’ sessions, targeting specific groups of people based on their email address, phone number, or a unique identifier on their phone, according to 404 Media’s own tests of ChatGPT’s advertising ecosystem.

blocks.text: While the ad targeting available in ChatGPT is somewhat standard practice across the advertising industry, the chatbot’s one billion monthly active users may not understand they, in some cases, are being specifically targeted because of their personal data the advertiser has uploaded to OpenAI. ChatGPT’s ad targeting is also novel in that it is also based on the prompts users enter into the chatbot, prompts that users may assume are private but which, as 404 Media has previously shown, may be reviewed by humans. Or in this case, used for ad targeting purposes.
